情态动词完成式:must / should / could have done: 对过去的推测与评价:must have done(肯定发生过)、should have done(本应)、needn't have done(本不必)。
must have done:过去一定发生过(肯定推测)|can't/couldn't have done:过去不可能|should/ought to have done:本应做而未做(责备)|shouldn't have done:本不该做却做了|could have done:本能够做却没做|needn't have done:本不必做却做了
The ground is wet; it must have rained last night.
column3: 地面是湿的,昨晚一定下过雨。
